stdx.description: Extensions to the Zig 0.16 standard library: fixed-capacity containers, strict parsers, IPv4 types, and the primitives std lacks.

compress.description: Compression codecs in pure Zig: Snappy, DEFLATE, gzip, zlib, and Zstandard, plus a Brotli decoder.

testingx.description: Plain-text tests and Go-style benchmarks for Zig 0.16.
